crystal_phase.Pd-Ni: mixture of Ni (200) face-centered cubic, and Ni (111) face centered cubic phases; Pd-Ni alloy

Proof in the paper: The X-ray powder diffraction (XRD) patterns (Figure 2a) suggested that PdNi particles (nominal composition of 5 wt %Pd-10 wt %Ni/HZSM-5) contained a mixture of Ni (200) face-centered cubic, and Ni (111) face centered cubic phases (48% and 52%, respectively); a small peak corresponding to the presence of a Pd-Ni alloy at a peak of ∼42.5° was also detected in the XRD pattern. The HRTEM image revealed that Pd-Ni was of high crystallinity and was composed of Pd-Ni alloy facets with a lattice distance of 0.21 nm. Single- or twin-crystallinity particles contained exposed Ni (111), Ni (200), and Pd (111), which was in agreement with XRD patterns (Figure 2a).
